title: Linebreaker Boots
summary: Dash during combat to add 3 turns of Wrath, even more than once in the same turn.

fields.Adrenaline Rush: Every Dash in combat adds 3 turns of Wrath. The tooltip’s two-turn duration and once-per-turn restriction differ from documented behavior.
fields.Wrath: +1 melee weapon damage per remaining turn of Wrath. Stacks up to 7, loses one at end of turn.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
